Atlas.intro: Choose an area and trace its property information back to the original sources.
Atlas.unavailable: These details could not be loaded. Please try again shortly.
Atlas.truncated: Preview limit reached; some records are omitted.
Atlas.limitations: Research preview. Parcels are not buildings or homes. Source coverage and dates must be checked for each area; a retrieval date does not establish permit validity.

Map.spatial: Spatial match; ownership and commercial identity are unconfirmed.
Map.imageryNote: Sentinel-2: 10 m per pixel. Annual composites combine multiple dates. Esri acquisition dates vary by tile. At close zoom, available imagery is enlarged without additional detail.
Map.searchPrompt: Name, street, usage or parcel code
Map.resetBearing: Drag to rotate map, click to reset north
Map.exploreHint: Select a project, building or parcel on the map.
Map.nearbyNote: Recorded places within 1.5 km, measured in a straight line from the mapped point or footprint centre. Coverage may be incomplete; opening status and walking routes are not verified.
Map.nearbyEmpty: No recorded amenities within this radius.
Map.overlapAlert: Another cadastral record overlaps this land.
Map.overlapNote: These distinct records have at least 80% mutual footprint overlap. Published uses may differ; neither record proves what is built here. Open each record to compare its source and dates.
Map.proximityMatch: Project association suggested from map proximity (within 50 m); unconfirmed. Distance to the parcel footprint.
Map.imageryCoverage: The selected source applies to the entire map. Missing imagery is never replaced with another source.
Map.imageryUnavailable: Imagery unavailable. Choose another source in View.
Map.catalogue3dNote: Green: recorded height. Sand: estimate (3 m per floor; otherwise 3 m). Volumes do not confirm construction status.
Map.world3dNote: OpenStreetMap volumes: heights may be estimated and coverage varies. No photographic façades.
Map.gesture3d: Tilt and rotate with two fingers on mobile, or right-drag on desktop. Zoom in to see buildings.
Map.threeDUnavailable: 3D context unavailable. Try the platform buildings or return to 2D.
Map.analysisScope: Search and counts cover loaded data only.
Map.drawHint: Click to place points. Enter finishes; Escape exits. Measurements are indicative.
Map.walkOrigin: Click the map to choose a starting point.
Map.walkPending: Preparing the calculation; this may take a few minutes.
Map.walkUnavailable: Walking calculation unavailable. Choose another point or try again.
Map.walkNote: OSM network estimate, without live traffic or timetables. Local access is not guaranteed.
Map.compareNote: Compared imagery is on the left. Annual mosaics do not date individual buildings.
Map.solarShadowNote: Flat-ground convex shadows, only for catalogue buildings with recorded heights. No mutual occlusion or interiors; hidden below 5° sun elevation.
Map.solarNote: Clear-sky scene lighting at the map centre. This does not measure weather, lux or indoor sunlight.
Map.marketMapNote: District aggregates for the selected snapshot and search. Mixed property types; rates require at least 5 values. Boundaries are current archived boundaries, not transaction locations.
Map.marketMissing: sales without an unambiguous mapped district
Map.coastlineNotice: The basemap coastline and cadastral limits come from different sources and may reflect different dates or planned land.

Coverage.title: Seven emirates. One platform.
Coverage.preparingBody: This territory has no activated dataset yet. Explore the Al Reem pilot while further sources are researched and validated.
Coverage.boundaryOnly: Official district boundaries across the emirate. Detailed property maps are currently available for Reem, Al Maryah and Saadiyat.

Market.title: Recent registered sales
Market.note: Registered sale prices, not current asking prices. Project names are reported by ADREC; building associations remain unverified.
Market.indexScope: Abu Dhabi City · all zones. These indices are not valuations of this property.
Market.review: Conflicting index series are withheld pending review.

Context.title: Living in Abu Dhabi
Context.unknownDate: The source publication date is unknown.
Context.healthScope: Public facility directory; locations and services may be outdated.
Context.schoolScope: ADEK Charter schools only. This is not a directory of all schools.
Context.mobilityScope: Published route endpoints. Stops, frequency and travel times are not included.
Context.statisticsScope: SCAD census totals by year and region. Counts are rounded to multiples of five.
Context.districtScope: Official Onwani boundaries for the three municipalities. These are not property inventories.
Context.archiveNote: Manually imported public document; automatic updates are currently unavailable.

Project.programmeNote: This total does not represent current availability.
Project.sourceNote: Original claims remain in their source language. Retrieval dates do not establish publication dates.
Project.unavailable: Project information is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
Project.noProjectsHint: Try another name or clear your search.
Project.directoryIntro: Discover projects across Reem, Al Maryah and Saadiyat. Explore the details, then find your next area.
Project.purchaseNote: Prices, availability and payment terms are not yet verified. Confirm current details with the developer.
Project.mapIntro: Discover buildings, streets and places across this neighbourhood.
Project.mapUnavailable: The neighbourhood map is unavailable. You can still open the main map.
Project.mapLocationPending: The exact project location is not documented yet. This map shows the neighbourhood.
Project.bedroomsUnspecified: Bedroom count not specified for this property type.
Project.relationNote: Each building or phase keeps its own page and sources. The grouping is reviewed from the cited source.
